generation_prompt: The robot uses its right hand to grasp the green cup around its upper sides, lift it from the table, and carry it over the blue plate. It lowers the cup upright onto the plate, opens its fingers to release it, and lifts the right hand clear, leaving the cup standing on the plate. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: Green cup stands upright on the blue plate; the right hand is open and visibly clear above/right of its rim, while the left hand remains idle.

arm_hand_roles.right: Sole manipulating hand; closes fingers and thumb around the cup, lifts and transports it to the plate, lowers it, releases, and lifts clear.
arm_hand_roles.left: Remains open and idle at the lower-left side throughout; provides no support and receives no transfer.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand task; no hand-to-hand transfer or human contact.

uncertainties: The exact first cup-base contact frame is partly obscured by the grasp and viewing angle; settled upright placement followed by visible release is established at the ending.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
